exactness_scope: self-adjoint real two-surface BO nuclear Hamiltonians
recoil-free initial COM model unless optional NR extension explicitly selected
localized dipole-weighted scattering states with required domains and stationary flux limit
canonical_projector: P_E=P_c*1_[0,S](H_f); P_c is selected dissociative reducing projector

moment.definition: sigma_m=int epsilon^m d sigma/d epsilon d epsilon
moment.operator: sigma_m = [V/(3*pi*epsilon0*hbar^4*c^3*v_i)] sum_a <D_a chi | P_E (S-H_f)^(m+3) | D_a chi> in stationary normalization limit
moment.final_boundary: repulsive Coulomb energy-normalized; not free Bessel

resolved_formal_items: positive support-projected spectral moment operator and flux normalization
local-gap error recurrence and state-dependent bound
separate nuclear commutator and spectral leakage terms
optional NR pair-COM recoil root plus delta Jacobian

recoil.model: optional nonrelativistic pair COM recoil only

not_certified: actual He continuum or potentials/dipole accuracy
